name: Siddharth Sharma
bio: With over 12+ years of professional engineering and interior design practice, Siddharth Sharma has pioneered the merging of civil structure dynamics with high-end interior form. He acts as the main program reviewer for AutoCAD structural standards, drafting analytics, and structural modeling at the Academy.
videoCaption: A quick introduction from Siddharth on his approach to structural design mentorship.

details.title: Industry Experience
details.content: Siddharth Sharma has 12+ years of industry experience in Structural Design. He has worked with construction companies like L&T, Tata Nest In, BHEL, Louis Berger Inc and provided structural design consultancy with EPTISA for smart city projects at Udaipur (Rajasthan) and Patna (Bihar). He has handled industrial projects with AVS for prestigious companies Hindustan Zinc Ltd., Adani Group, TATA Group, PI Industries, Shree Cement Ltd, BPCL, Wolkem Industries Ltd, JK Paper, Jubilant Industries, etc.

details.title: Projects Executed
items: Udaipur Smart City structural consultancy (EPTISA) — Rajasthan
Patna Smart City structural consultancy (EPTISA) — Bihar
Industrial structural projects via AVS for PSU & private majors

name: Shantanu Sharma
bio: An acclaimed academician and practicing architect registered under the Council of Architecture (C.O.A). Shantanu’s architectural design philosophy centers on context-driven urban form, architectural drafting compliance, and space layout optimization. He supervises drafting protocols and site drawing workshops.
videoCaption: Shantanu shares his philosophy on context-driven architecture and urban form.

details.title: Industry Experience
details.content: Shantanu Sharma brings 15+ years of architectural practice, registered under the Council of Architecture (C.O.A). He has led context-driven urban design, architectural drafting compliance, and large-scale space planning across residential, commercial, and civic projects, while mentoring students on drafting protocols and site drawing standards.

name: Manan Agrawal
bio: An expert in leveraging design-thinking for product scaling and software architecture. Manan brings direct corporate insights from top US management firms and high-scale technical systems to Nuvosid students. He leads UI foundations, design sprints, and product deployment strategies.
videoCaption: Manan on bridging design-thinking with product and business strategy.

details.title: Industry Experience
details.content: Manan Agrawal has 10+ years across product strategy, software architecture, and design-thinking. A graduate of IIT Delhi and the Wharton School (USA), he brings corporate insights from top US management firms and high-scale technical systems, and leads UI foundations, design sprints, and product deployment strategy for Nuvosid cohorts.

details.title: Projects Executed
items: Design sprint facilitation for design teams

name: Kritik Kothari
bio: Kritik leads interactive growth-hacking and product positioning classes for our digital design cohorts. He bridges the gap between creative visual designs and business outcomes, mentoring students on how to pitch their design deliverables and portfolio cases to corporate stakeholders.
education: MBA, S.P. Jain School of Management
videoCaption: Kritik on turning design deliverables into business outcomes.

details.title: Industry Experience
details.content: Kritik Kothari has 8+ years leading growth-hacking and product positioning for digital design cohorts. An S.P. Jain MBA and growth specialist, he bridges creative design and business outcomes, mentoring students on pitching design deliverables and portfolio cases to corporate stakeholders.

details.title: Projects Executed
items: Growth strategy for digital design cohorts

name: A.K. Sharma
bio: A veteran engineer with 30+ years of structural supervision, government project consultancy, and regulatory bylaws validation. A.K. Sharma provides expert advice on construction drawings, bid tenders, drafting guidelines, and construction law compliance to help students build legally sound structures.
videoCaption: A.K. Sharma on building legally sound, compliant structures.

details.title: Industry Experience
details.content: A.K. Sharma is a veteran engineer with 30+ years in structural supervision, government project consultancy, and regulatory bylaws validation. He advises students and clients on construction drawings, bid tenders, drafting guidelines, and construction-law compliance to help build legally sound structures.
